description_target.target_text: Each shape: if has thin tail (perp dim 1, len>=2), move main rect by tail length; else rectangularize to bbox. Moved shapes render on top.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (define h (rows g))
  (define w (cols g))
  (define colors (filter (lambda (c) (not (= c 0))) (grid-colors g)))
  (define (color-cells c) (find-color g c))
  (define (in-cells? cellset r c)
    (any? (lambda (p) (and (= (first p) r) (= (second p) c))) cellset))
  (define (rect-fits cellset r1 c1 r2 c2)
    (andmap (lambda (p) (in-cells? cellset (first p) (second p)))
            (positions-in-rect r1 c1 r2 c2)))
  (define (largest-rect cells)
    (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
           (br1 (first bb)) (bc1 (second bb)) (br2 (third bb)) (bc2 (fourth bb))
           (all-rects
             (apply append
               (map (lambda (r1)
                      (apply append
                        (map (lambda (c1)
                               (apply append
                                 (map (lambda (r2)
                                        (filter (lambda (rc) rc)
                                          (map (lambda (c2)
                                                 (if (and (>= r2 r1) (>= c2 c1) (rect-fits cells r1 c1 r2 c2))
                                                     (list r1 c1 r2 c2 (* (+ (- r2 r1) 1) (+ (- c2 c1) 1)))
                                                     #f))
                                               (range bc1 (+ bc2 1)))))
                                      (range br1 (+ br2 1)))))
                             (range bc1 (+ bc2 1)))))
                    (range br1 (+ br2 1))))))
      (let ((best (reduce (lambda (acc r)
                            (if (> (nth r 4) (nth acc 4)) r acc))
                          (list br1 bc1 br1 bc1 1)
                          all-rects)))
        (list (nth best 0) (nth best 1) (nth best 2) (nth best 3)))))
  (define (process-color c)
    (let* ((cells (color-cells c))
           (bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
           (br1 (first bb)) (bc1 (second bb)) (br2 (third bb)) (bc2 (fourth bb))
           (lr (largest-rect cells))
           (mr1 (nth lr 0)) (mc1 (nth lr 1)) (mr2 (nth lr 2)) (mc2 (nth lr 3))
           (main-cells (positions-in-rect mr1 mc1 mr2 mc2))
           (tail-cells (filter (lambda (p) (not (any? (lambda (m) (= m p)) main-cells))) cells))
           (bbox-cells (positions-in-rect br1 bc1 br2 bc2)))
      (if (null? tail-cells)
          (list bbox-cells c #f)
          (let* ((tail-bb (bbox-of-cells tail-cells))
                 (tr1 (first tail-bb)) (tc1 (second tail-bb))
                 (tr2 (third tail-bb)) (tc2 (fourth tail-bb))
                 (th (+ (- tr2 tr1) 1)) (tw (+ (- tc2 tc1) 1))
                 (dir (cond
                        ((> tr1 mr2) 'down)
                        ((< tr2 mr1) 'up)
                        ((> tc1 mc2) 'right)
                        ((< tc2 mc1) 'left)
                        (else 'none)))
                 (perp-1?
                   (cond ((or (= dir 'down) (= dir 'up)) (= tw 1))
                         ((or (= dir 'right) (= dir 'left)) (= th 1))
                         (else #f)))
                 (tlen (cond ((or (= dir 'down) (= dir 'up)) th)
                             ((or (= dir 'right) (= dir 'left)) tw)
                             (else 0)))
                 (full-tail? (= (length tail-cells) (* th tw)))
                 (long? (>= tlen 2)))
            (if (and perp-1? full-tail? long?)
                (let* ((dr (cond ((= dir 'down) tlen) ((= dir 'up) (- 0 tlen)) (else 0)))
                       (dc (cond ((= dir 'right) tlen) ((= dir 'left) (- 0 tlen)) (else 0)))
                       (new-cells (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first p) dr) (+ (second p) dc))) main-cells)))
                  (list new-cells c #t))
                (list bbox-cells c #f))))))
  (define processed (map process-color colors))
  (define non-moved (filter (lambda (p) (not (nth p 2))) processed))
  (define moved (filter (lambda (p) (nth p 2)) processed))
  (define empty-g (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (r c) 0)))
  (define (place gg shapes)
    (reduce (lambda (g1 sh)
              (let ((cs (first sh)) (col (second sh)))
                (paint-cells g1 cs col)))
            gg shapes))
  (place (place empty-g non-moved) moved)))
racket_target.target_code:
(rule!
 ;; Each color = a solid BODY rectangle plus (maybe) a 1-wide TAIL
 ;; arrow. A straight solid tail of length 2+ launches its body: the
 ;; body jumps tail-length cells in the tail's direction and the tail
 ;; vanishes. A shape without such a tail settles as its filled
 ;; bounding box. Jumpers paint over settlers.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (largest-rect-in cells)  ;; scan order = tiebreak, as before
       (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
         (rest
          (for*/fold ((best (list 1 (first bb) (second bb)
                                  (first bb) (second bb))))
                     ((r1 (range (first bb) (+ (third bb) 1)))
                      (c1 (range (second bb) (+ (fourth bb) 1)))
                      (r2 (range (first bb) (+ (third bb) 1)))
                      (c2 (range (second bb) (+ (fourth bb) 1))))
            (if (and (>= r2 r1) (>= c2 c1)
                     (> (* (+ 1 (- r2 r1)) (+ 1 (- c2 c1)))
                        (first best))
                     (all? (lambda (p) (member p cells))
                           (positions-in-rect r1 c1 r2 c2)))
                (list (* (+ 1 (- r2 r1)) (+ 1 (- c2 c1))) r1 c1 r2 c2)
                best)))))
     (define (process c)  ;; -> (cells color moved?)
       (let* ((cells (find-color g c))
              (bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
              (body (largest-rect-in cells))
              (body-cells (positions-in-rect (first body) (second body)
                                             (third body) (fourth body)))
              (tail (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p body-cells)))
                            cells))
              (settled (list (positions-in-rect (first bb) (second bb)
                                                (third bb) (fourth bb))
                             c #f)))
         (if (null? tail)
             settled
             (let* ((tb (bbox-of-cells tail))
                    (th (+ 1 (- (third tb) (first tb))))
                    (tw (+ 1 (- (fourth tb) (second tb))))
                    (dir (cond ((> (first tb) (third body)) 'down)
                               ((< (third tb) (first body)) 'up)
                               ((> (second tb) (fourth body)) 'right)
                               ((< (fourth tb) (second body)) 'left)
                               (else 'none)))
                    (vert (member? dir (list 'down 'up)))
                    (tlen (if vert th tw)))
               (if (and (not (eq? dir 'none))
                        (= 1 (if vert tw th))
                        (= (length tail) (* th tw))
                        (>= tlen 2))
                   (let ((dr (cond ((eq? dir 'down) tlen)
                                   ((eq? dir 'up) (- 0 tlen))
                                   (else 0)))
                         (dc (cond ((eq? dir 'right) tlen)
                                   ((eq? dir 'left) (- 0 tlen))
                                   (else 0))))
                     (list (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first p) dr)
                                                  (+ (second p) dc)))
                               body-cells)
                           c #t))
                   settled)))))
     (define processed
       (map process (filter (lambda (c) (> c 0)) (grid-colors g))))
     (for/fold ((out (for/fold ((o (empty-grid h w 0)))
                               ((s (filter (lambda (p) (not (third p)))
                                           processed)))
                       (paint-cells o (first s) (second s)))))
               ((s (filter third processed)))
       (paint-cells out (first s) (second s))))))
